units.source_text: 薰中纳言为答谢祝贺，拜访前尚侍玉鬘夫人，在正殿庭前拜舞。

en.t: Junior Counsellor Kaoru went to thank Lady Tamakazura, the former Naishi no Kami, for her congratulations, and performed a formal dance of homage in the garden before the main hall.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人出来和他会面，说道：“如此蓬门草舍之家，猥蒙不弃其陋，盛情深可感谢。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura came out to meet him and said, “For you not to disdain such a humble, overgrown house as this is a kindness for which I am deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 使我回想六条院主在世时的旧事，不胜依恋之情。”

en.t: It makes me remember the old days when the master of Rokujo-in was alive, and I cannot help longing for them.”

units.source_text: 声音优雅而婉转，其娇嫩动人听闻。

en.t: Her voice was elegant and gentle, with a tender charm that moved anyone who heard it.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“她真是永远不老的啊！

en.t: Kaoru thought, “She truly never grows old.

units.source_text: 原来如此，所以冷泉院对她的怨恨至今不绝。

en.t: So that is why Reizei-in’s resentment toward her has never ended even now.

units.source_text: 看来今后终于要发生什么事呢。”

en.t: It seems that something is bound to happen from now on.”

units.source_text: 便回答道：“升官晋爵等事，区区何足挂齿！

en.t: He answered, “Promotion and rank are trifles hardly worth mentioning.

units.source_text: 小弟今日专为叩访而来。

en.t: Today I have come only to pay my respects to you.

units.source_text: 大姐说‘不弃其陋’，想是责我平日疏慢之罪了？”

en.t: When you speak of my not disdaining this place, elder sister, are you perhaps reproaching me for my usual neglect?”

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人道：“今日是向你庆贺之日，非老身诉愁说恨之时。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura said, “Today is a day to congratulate you, not a time for this old woman to pour out complaints and grievances.

units.source_text: 我本不好意思讲，但你特地来访，机会亦甚难得。

en.t: I was reluctant to speak of it, but since you have come especially to visit, the chance is very rare.

units.source_text: 且此等琐屑之事，又不便转达，非面谈不可。

en.t: Besides, such small matters are hard to convey through others and must be discussed face to face.

units.source_text: 因此只得直说了：我家入院的那个人，处境困难，心情痛苦，几乎难于容身。

en.t: So I must speak plainly: the one from our house who entered the Retired Emperor’s service is in a difficult position, suffers greatly at heart, and can scarcely find a place for herself.

units.source_text: 当初有弘徽殿女御照拂，又得秋好皇后许可，还能安心度日。

en.t: At first, with the Kokiden Consort looking after her and Empress Akikonomu’s approval as well, she could pass her days in peace.

units.source_text: 但现在两人都怪怨她无礼，认为不可容恕。

en.t: But now both of them resent her as discourteous and consider her conduct unforgivable.

units.source_text: 她不胜痛苦，只得抛下皇子皇女，乞假还家，且图安心休养。

en.t: Unable to bear the pain, she has had no choice but to leave the prince and princess behind, ask for leave, and return home in hopes of resting in peace.

units.source_text: 因此外人说长道短，上皇亦深为不满。

en.t: Because of this, outsiders gossip, and the Retired Emperor too is deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 你倘遇有机会，务望向上皇善为说辞。

en.t: If you should have the opportunity, I beg you to speak tactfully on her behalf to the Retired Emperor.

units.source_text: 当初仰仗各方庇护而毅然入院之时，诸人都安然相处，开诚相待。

en.t: When she first relied on everyone’s protection and boldly entered his service, all the people concerned lived together peacefully and treated one another with openness.

units.source_text: 岂料今日如此相左。

en.t: Who could have expected matters to turn out so at odds today?

units.source_text: 可知我思虑疏浅，不自量力，真乃后悔莫及也！”

en.t: Now I see that my judgment was shallow and that I overreached myself; truly, regret comes too late!”

units.source_text: 说罢叹息不已。

en.t: After saying this, she sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“据小弟看来，决不至于如此可忧。

en.t: Kaoru replied, “As I see it, there is certainly no need to worry so much.

units.source_text: 入宫见妒，乃古来常有之事。

en.t: For a woman to enter the palace and meet jealousy is something that has always happened.

units.source_text: 冷泉院已经退位，正思闲居静处，凡事都不喜铺张夸耀。

en.t: Reizei-in has already retired from the throne and wishes to live quietly, and he dislikes display or ostentation in anything.

units.source_text: 因此后宫谁都希望逍遥自在地度送岁月。

en.t: For that reason, everyone in the inner palace hopes to pass the years at ease and without constraint.

units.source_text: 只是各位后妃心中，总难免互相竞争。

en.t: Still, in the hearts of the consorts, rivalry with one another is hard to avoid.

units.source_text: 在他人看来，这有什么关系呢！

en.t: To outsiders, what does any of that matter?

units.source_text: 但当事人总是心怀怨恨。

en.t: But those directly involved always harbor resentment.

units.source_text: 每逢小事细故，就动嫉妒之心，这原是女御、后妃们常有的习癖。

en.t: To become jealous over every little matter is, after all, a common habit among court ladies and consorts.

units.source_text: 难道当初入院时连这一点点纠纷都不曾预料到么？

en.t: Could such a small dispute really not have been foreseen when she first entered his service?

units.source_text: 我看今后只要心平气和，凡事都不计较，就没事了。

en.t: I think that from now on, if she keeps calm and takes nothing too seriously, all will be well.

units.source_text: 此种事情，我们男子是不便过问的。”

en.t: In matters of this kind, it is difficult for us men to interfere.”

units.source_text: 他率直地答复。

en.t: He answered her frankly.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人笑道：“我想等你来时向你诉苦，岂知白费心思，被你干脆地驳倒了。”

en.t: Lady Tamakazura laughed and said, “I had thought I would wait until you came and complain to you, but it seems my effort was wasted, and you have flatly refuted me.”

units.source_text: 她的态度不像母亲关怀女儿那么认真，却很轻快而有风趣。

en.t: Her manner was not as grave as a mother deeply worried for her daughter, but lighthearted and full of charm.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“她的女儿大约也有这种风度吧。

en.t: Kaoru thought, “Her daughter must surely have this same kind of grace.

units.source_text: 我之所以恋慕宇治八亲王的大女儿，也是为了贪爱她有这种风度。”

en.t: The reason I longed for the elder daughter of the Eighth Prince of Uji was also that I loved this same quality in her.”

units.source_text: 此时当了尚侍的二女公子也乞假在家。

en.t: At that time, the second young lady, who had become Naishi no Kami, was also at home on leave.

units.source_text: 薰君知道两女公子都住在家里，颇感兴趣。

en.t: When Kaoru learned that both young ladies were staying at home, he felt considerable interest.

units.source_text: 推想她们闲暇无事，大概都在帘内看他，觉得难为情起来，便努力装出一脉斯文的模样。

en.t: Imagining that, with nothing to do, they were probably watching him from behind the blinds, he grew embarrassed and made an effort to appear refined and composed.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人看了，想道：“此人倒可当我女婿。”

en.t: Seeing this, Lady Tamakazura thought, “This man would actually make a suitable son-in-law for me.”
